headline: Sindh Chief Minister Murad Ali Shah invited Huawei to set up R&D facilities or technology labs in Karachi during a visit to its Lianqiu Lake R&D Centre in Shanghai.

card.desc: CM Murad wants tech labs at Karachi Education City

caption:
Sindh Chief Minister Murad Ali Shah invited Huawei to set up R&D facilities or technology labs in Karachi, linked to Karachi Education City, Dawn and The Express Tribune reported. During a visit to Huawei's Lianqiu Lake R&D Centre in Shanghai, he also proposed cooperation on a government cloud, data centres, cybersecurity and AI computing.
